scripts.dev: concurrently -n ai,api,web -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev:ai" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:ai: cd ai && (test -d .venv || python3.10 -m venv .venv) && .venv/bin/pip install -q -r requirements.txt && KNOWLEDGE_DIR=../server/knowledge/runbooks .venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8092
scripts.dev:node-only: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.docker:build: docker build -f ai/Dockerfile -t loglens-ai:0.1 . && docker build -f server/Dockerfile -t loglens-api:0.1 . && docker build -f client/Dockerfile -t loglens-web:0.1 .
